review.imagery: Root reviewed all 53 Maysan brochure pages, all 34 Phase 2 brochure pages, 37 extracted native resources and eleven current website candidates. The selected 25 renders retain Phase 2, earlier Maysan or current-gallery scope. Generic water, decorative textures, icons and duplicate compositions were excluded. The listing image is the Phase 2 tower render. Earlier Maysan scenes remain explicitly labelled and do not establish Phase 2 views, specifications or amenity entitlements.
review.floorPlans: Root read all 78 delivered complete pages and every visible average-GSA panel. Fifteen Phase 2 layouts print 74/75/87,145/142/145/145/137/142/141/113/157,192/187/340 m². The 340 is visibly printed and retains its conflict with the current 240 maximum. The drawing pack supplies seventeen layout spreads and fifteen whole key plans. The original Maysan brochure adds thirteen edition-specific layouts and thirteen whole key plans. Its 88/80/108/73,133/134/142/145/99/107,185/182/191 averages and building keys differ from the separate pack. No universal cross-edition area or per-level multiplication was inferred. Five complete map/amenity spreads retain separate phase scope. Original three PDFs, bilingual notices and physical pages remain preserved.
review.location: Root read both complete original regional maps, both amenity maps, original Maysan master plan and current official Phase 2 JPEG. The current and Phase 2 brochure destination estimates agree. The old Maysan map marks southern Reem Island, while Phase 2 marks the Al Maryah-facing location. These sources remain distinct. The Hudayriyat sales centre is excluded as a project pin. No final entrance coordinate, live route, journey mode or kilometre distance was inferred. Disneyland proposed-resort scope follows the primary chapter announcement.
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts preserve current HTML and image/map resources and all three original broker-hosted PDFs with retrieval dates, bytes and SHA256. Selected native resources preserve exact original bytes and physical pages. Complete pages were rendered with Poppler and losslessly delivered. Existing researched commercial data, historical payment conflict and all protected identities remain preserved.

unavailable: Contracted phase, current selected unit and building, final measured area and revision, source-edition geographical relationship, confirmed finishes and amenity entitlements, surveyed entrance coordinates and current routes remain unverified. Phase 2 Type C 340 m² conflicts with the current website maximum of 240 m².
